What This Tool Does
For Doctors: Acts as a `< 50 ms` second reader that flags subtle secondary knee injuries (hidden fluid swelling, bone bruises, meniscus surface tears) and lets you inspect `1.65×` enhanced tissue vs. a healthy knee MRI.
For Patients: Translates complex radiology reports into a clear 12-Structure Knee Pathology Review and questions for your orthopedic visit.

    How the 3D Volume Scanner Picks the Best Slice Automatically

    A full knee MRI contains 100+ slices across 3 planes. OpenCV 5 crops empty air borders, enhances cartilage contrast (`CLAHE`), and feeds 16 2.5D slabs into our Gated Attention network, locking onto the exact slice where the tear is sharpest.
